name: UNDEFEATED: Genesis
description:
About This Game

POWER ALONE DOES NOT MAKE A HERO

Choosing to protect someone does.

Albert Hartree, known as Al, has always admired heroes. When he is suddenly transported to the alien planet Voltissia and awakens to extraordinary powers, his childhood dream becomes a reality.

Stranded far from home, Al joins forces with the Enelf, the survivors of a civilization destroyed by the Calamity. To protect them and find a way home, he must learn to control his powers and discover what it truly means to become a hero.

TAKE TO THE SKIES

Fly freely across the vast world of Voltissia. Soar above shattered landscapes, cross enormous distances at incredible speed, and experience an alien world from both the ground and the sky.

Flight is more than a way to travel. It shapes how you explore, approach danger, and launch into battle with speed and momentum.

MASTER EXTRAORDINARY POWERS

Push beyond human limits with powerful abilities built around movement, combat, and spectacular impact.

Unlock new superpowers and abilities throughout your journey. Each one expands your options, opening new ways to explore Voltissia, confront enemies, and develop your own approach to battle.

Grow from a newly awakened hero into a force capable of facing Voltissia’s greatest threats.

RISE AS VOLTISSIA’S HOPE

Five hundred years ago, a mysterious explosion destroyed Voltissia’s civilization and transformed much of its life into brutal mutants. The surviving Enelf now struggle to endure among the ruins.

Explore a vast alien world filled with towering landscapes, lost civilizations, and dangerous creatures. Battle powerful enemies, protect the Enelf, and confront a new threat emerging on Voltissia.

A NEW GENERATION OF UNDEFEATED

UNDEFEATED: Genesis is a brand new premium game created by core members of the team behind the original UNDEFEATED.

With a new story, a vast alien world, expanded progression, and reimagined combat and flight, Genesis delivers a new superhero adventure built around greater freedom, scale, and impact.

BECOME UNDEFEATED

Al has been given extraordinary power. Now he must prove that he has the heart of a hero.

Take flight. Face the dangers ahead. Become the hero Voltissia needs.
short_desc: Become the hero Voltissia needs. Fly freely across a vast alien planet, master extraordinary superpowers, and battle ferocious mutants in an expansive superhero action RPG.
